arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation: Narrated Umar ibn Al-Khattab: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'The deeds are considered by the intentions, and a person will get the reward according to what he has intended.'
Narrated Umar ibn Al-Khattab: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'Actions are but by intentions and every man shall have only that which he intended.'

Narrated Ibn Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Islam is based on (the following) five (principles): 1. To testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger. 2. To offer the (compulsory congregational) prayers dutifully and perfectly. 3. To pay Zakat (i.e. obligatory charity). 4. To perform Hajj. (i.e. Pilgrimage to Mecca) 5. To observe fast during the month of Ramadan.

Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The five daily prayers and from one Friday prayer to the next are expiation for whatever sins come in between, so long as one does not commit any major sin.'
Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.'
Narrated Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The best among you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best among you to my family.'

arabic: لاَ يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لاَ يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'He who does not thank people, does not thank Allah.'

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَامِكُمْ
translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.'
Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.'
Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.'
